name: Divider set to customer drawer envelope

coordinate_frame.origin: centre of the divider set footprint

datums.description: outer footprint of the assembled lane block

allowed: lift the block out of the drawer
constrained: block sliding when the drawer is opened

assembly.sequence_notes: The drawer is customer-supplied; its envelope is a configurator input, never an assumed value.

uncontrolled: drawer size, corner radii and depth

keepouts_and_access: No structural, load-bearing or anti-tip claim.
Never assume a drawer size; it is always an input.

evidence.uncertainty_note: The drawer is customer-owned and unknown by design. The product is parametric precisely because this interface cannot be fixed.

failure_modes.mode: The generated block does not fit the entered drawer.
failure_modes.mitigation: Validate configurator inputs against the print envelope and emit a dimensional check sheet with every release.

acceptance_criteria: The generated footprint never exceeds the entered drawer envelope minus the declared placement clearance.
The generated block stays inside the 220 x 180 x 80 mm planning envelope or is split into modules.
